prompt:
Edit the supplied 18-piece game character atlas to fix anatomically incorrect cutout segmentation. Preserve the exact face, costume identity, palette, brushwork, and exact eighteen isolated component layout. Transparent background, landscape 1536x1024. The sheet will be rigged and animated: literal anatomical segmentation is mandatory.
Top row, six items: head with front hair and short neck; rear hair; complete neck-to-hip garment core; cape; main weapon; secondary held object.
Middle row, six items: anatomical LEFT upper arm, LEFT forearm, LEFT hand; anatomical RIGHT upper arm, RIGHT forearm, RIGHT hand. Upper arm means SHOULDER TO ELBOW ONLY: shoulder pauldron and upper-arm material, no wrist cuff, no forearm length. Forearm means ELBOW TO WRIST ONLY: no shoulder pauldron, no hand. Hand means wrist attachment plus fingers only, NO DUPLICATED CUFF or sleeve. Every proximal and distal cut has a softly shaded rounded underlap, closed solid paint, no hollow socket or dark outline across the attachment. Keep upper arm and forearm same painting scale. Keep physical shoulder-elbow and elbow-wrist lengths close to equal. Elbow is NOT a wrist.
Bottom row, six items: LEFT thigh, LEFT shin, LEFT foot; RIGHT thigh, RIGHT shin, RIGHT foot. Thigh means HIP TO KNEE ONLY, not calf. Place ONE knee guard on the bottom of the thigh if this hero has armored knees. Stop the thigh just below the knee guard, short rounded underlap. Shin means KNEE TO ANKLE ONLY, smooth proximal underlap, NEVER A SECOND KNEE GUARD and NO FOOT. Foot means ankle with shoe only, no whole shin. The knee hinge lies inside the single knee guard. Naked knees must have soft overlapping flesh without black cut line. No duplicate gold star, kneecap or cuff between adjacent pieces.
Core torso must end in skirt/hip garment, REMOVE ALL painted bare-thigh stubs or attached legs from this third top component: the separate thighs provide all thigh skin. All limb pieces face the same slight three-quarter direction as the head and torso. Neutral straight limbs, no extreme bends. Each part entirely inside its own cell, 28px transparent gutters, no components touching or overlapping. Keep all head/hair/cape/weapon designs identical to source. Weapons must remain clean isolated complete designs. Do not add any text, labels, skeleton markers, whole assembled character, hands attached to weapons, glow, background matte or shadows outside pieces.
Character-specific corrections: Thigh components currently include most of the calf and knee stars twice. Shorten each thigh to stop immediately under its ONE knee guard. Remove duplicated knee stars from BOTH shins; shins are plain tapered silver lower-leg armor ending at ankle. Only forearm pieces contain wrist gauntlet cuff. Hands are short armored gloves; right hand firmly closed around vertical spear, left shield support. Preserve broad fur collar and spear/shield designs.
